feature1.label: Overview
feature1.title: What This Emoji Translator Is Good At
feature1.description: Built for messaging, captions, and quick social replies. Instead of a single emoji dump, you get three tone-aware variants with the reasoning behind each one.

items.title: Three modes, one tool
items.description: Add emoji to a message, translate text into emoji, or explain what an emoji message might mean — switch modes without leaving the page.

items.title: Reasoning, not just emoji
items.description: Every variant comes with a reason explaining the emoji choice, so you understand why it works before you send it.

items.title: Ambiguity cautions
items.description: When emoji could be read differently in context, the variant flags it — so you avoid sending the wrong signal.

items.title: What does the Emoji Translator do?
items.description: It takes a message and produces three emoji variants: it can add fitting emoji to your text, translate text into emoji, or explain what an emoji message might mean in context. Each variant includes a reason and an optional caution.

items.title: What are the three modes?
items.description: 'Add emoji' keeps your original words and appends emoji that reinforce the meaning. 'Translate to emoji' rewrites the message in an emoji-forward way. 'Explain emoji' interprets the emoji in your message as a possible reading, never a definitive one.

items.title: Why do variants include a caution?
items.description: Emoji meaning depends on context, relationship, and culture. A caution flags when a reading could be misinterpreted, so you can think twice before sending.

items.title: Does the tool change what my message says?
items.description: In 'add' mode your original text is preserved and only emoji are appended. In 'translate' mode the message is rewritten to convey the same meaning with emoji. The tool will not introduce harmful, sexualized, or slur-based substitutions.

items.title: Is the Emoji Translator free?
items.description: Yes. The Emoji Translator is free to use. No account is required.

items.title: What languages does it support?
items.description: The interface is available in English, Chinese, German, Korean, Japanese, and Russian, and the explanations are written in the language you select.
